verdict.rationale: The only evidence of region choice is a community thread on Fastmail's new EU (Amsterdam) region, which notes that Fastmail says it cannot guarantee data stays only in the EU. Another user describes data falling under both Australian and American jurisdictions given Fastmail's hosting locations. So some region option appears to exist, but true residency control is limited and has no first-party documentation in this pack. Missing for 10: first-party docs on region selection, a guaranteed residency commitment, a list of available regions and how to choose one, and independent hands-on confirmation.
